description: This file implements object management functions for the Ansc Object Container, including functions for object registration, creation by name, oid, type, and retrieval by runtime id. It defines methods for registering and creating objects within the container, primarily acting as wrappers around an internal object mapper.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscOcoRegisterObject1(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * objectName,ULONG oid,void * pfnCreate,void * pfnRemove)
methods.description: Registers a feature object with a specified name and oid, providing create and remove routines.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscOcoRegisterObject2(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * objectName,ULONG oid,char * baseObjectName,ULONG baseOid,char * derivedType,ULONG brokerOid,void * pfnCreate,void * pfnRemove)
methods.description: Registers a feature object with additional metadata including base object info, derived type, and broker oid, along with create and remove routines.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscOcoCreateObjectByName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,char * objectName)
methods.description: Creates a container object based on the object name, using the internal object mapper.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscOcoCreateObjectByOid(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ULONG oid)
methods.description: Creates a container object based on the object oid, using the internal object mapper.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscOcoCreateObjectByType(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,char * baseObjectName,char * derivedType)
methods.description: Creates a container object based on the base object name and derived type.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscOcoGetObjectByRid(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG rid)
methods.description: Retrieves an object handle based on its runtime object ID.
